compiled_state.title: GREEN: Implement validate-review-output.sh 2-key schema (remove scores requirement)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: validate-review-output.sh accepts reviewer-findings.json with exactly two top-level keys (findings, summary) and rejects files containing a scores key

## Files to modify
plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh

## Implementation

**Section 1: Schema change for code-review-dispatch prompt ID (lines ~227-297)**

Change:
  required_top = {"scores", "findings", "summary"}
To:
  required_top = {"findings", "summary"}

Change:
  allowed_top = required_top | optional_top
  # After: scores key becomes DISALLOWED (not just missing from required)
  # If a findings file contains a 'scores' key, it must be rejected:
  disallowed_top = {"scores"}
  extra_top = actual_top - allowed_top - disallowed_top
  # Treat presence of scores key as an error:
  if disallowed_top & actual_top:
      errors.append(f"reviewer-findings.json must not contain a 'scores' key (schema v2 — severity-only)")

**Section 2: Remove scores validation (lines ~249-320)**

Remove the entire scores validation block:
- Lines that check isinstance(scores, dict)
- Lines that validate required_dims
- Lines that validate 1-5 range for each score

**Section 3: Remove score-severity cross-validation (lines ~310-350)**

Remove the cross-validation block that checks:
- severity == 'critical' and score > 2 → error
- Score-based consistency checks

**Section 4: Update the OK output format**

The script currently prints SCHEMA_VALID: yes/no. Keep this format, but remove score-related output.

**Important: record-review.sh has its OWN embedded Python validator** (around line 262). That validator also parses scores. The record-review.sh changes are handled in Task T6 (separate task). Do NOT modify record-review.sh in this task.

## Verification
Run: bash tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh
- 2-key schema passes
- 3-key schema with scores key fails
- Existing review-protocol tests still pass (those are a different prompt-id and use a different schema path)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] validate-review-output.sh does not contain required_top with "scores"
  Verify: ! grep -q '"scores", "findings", "summary"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh
- [ ] 2-key schema accepted: exits 0 for {findings:[],summary:"..."} fixture
  Verify: TMPF=$(mktemp); echo '{"findings":[],"summary":"clean"}' > "$TMPF"; bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh code-review-dispatch "$TMPF"; rm -f "$TMPF"
- [ ] 3-key schema with scores rejected: exits non-zero for {scores:{...},findings:[],summary:"..."}
  Verify: TMPF=$(mktemp); echo '{"scores":{"hygiene":5,"design":5,"maintainability":5,"correctness":5,"verification":5},"findings":[],"summary":"..."}' > "$TMPF"; ! bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh code-review-dispatch "$TMPF"; rm -f "$TMPF"
- [ ] test-validate-review-output.sh suite passes
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: TRANSITION BEHAVIOR — validate-review-output.sh must NOT immediately reject scores key in this story (Story 1). The reviewer agents still emit scores until Story 2 (f19a-c97e). Instead, validate-review-output.sh should: (1) ACCEPT 2-key schema {findings, summary} without scores — this is the new behavior to test and verify, (2) Continue TOLERATING 3-key schema {scores, findings, summary} with a deprecation warning to stderr, (3) Update comment that scores is being deprecated. The done definition 'rejects files containing a scores key' applies to the FINAL state after Story 2 updates all agent files. This ensures the review pipeline remains functional during the transition between Story 1 and Story 2.
